summary: The M1186-M1191 evidence chain is internally consistent and materially advances the Signal/Rune vertical slice, but the first-release Stage 12 checklist remains blocked. Current evidence proves local four-room composition, current source/staged/served identity for selected M1188 files, and an exact loaded M1188 RuntimeProfile/artifact descriptor under Gamemaster. It does not prove persistent-world promotion, write/execution authority, Tram/Core final maps, player/Regionwright behavior, player acceptance, Stage 12 acceptance, or Ready-to-Play.

blockerDisposition: Keep loadedByteHashClaimed=false; selected served parity does not prove loaded byte authority beyond the descriptor observation.
Keep fixture-memory create/readback separate from persistent-world promotion.
Keep document/Scene/placeable/Region/media write capabilities unavailable and execution authority unclaimed.
Keep Tram/Core final-map-required until reviewed final-map evidence exists.
Keep player behavior, Regionwright integration, and player acceptance unclaimed.
Keep Stage 12 acceptance and Ready-to-Play false.
